basic_details.job_title: IIT Hyderabad Office Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IIT Hyderabad) has announced 1 vacancy for the Office Assistant post on a contract basis, initially for a period of 11 months with potential extension based on performance and requirements. Candidates applying for the post must possess Any Degree with at least 65% marks (First class and distinction) and a minimum of five years of experience in office work, along with good communication and management skills. The notified consolidated pay is Rs. 23,000 per month. Eligible applicants must apply online using the provided Google form link from 15 October 2

important_dates.interview_date: To be informed after shortlisting (Online mode)

how_to_apply: Access the online application form using the Google form link provided below.
Fill in all the required personal and academic details accurately in the online application.
Submit the application before 05:00 pm on 20 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Office Assistant at a Glance
Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational qualifications and experience requirements specified by the department.

rows.essential_qualification: Any Degree with at least 65% marks (First class and distinction), and a minimum of five years of experience in office work, along with good communication and management skills.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 23,000/- per month. The appointment is on an ad hoc (contract basis) initially for a period of 11 months. Based on performance, the appointment can be extended further depending on the requirements of the department.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Hyderabad Office Assistant
content_sections.text: Access the online application form using the Google form link provided below. Fill in all the required personal and academic details accurately in the online application. Submit the application before 05:00 pm on 20 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their academic background and relevant experience. Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the date of interviews. The mode of interview is online.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in IIT Hyderabad Office Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Office Assistant post in the Department of Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Hyderabad Office Assistant?
faq.answer: The last date for applying is 20 October 2026 up to 05:00 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold any degree with at least 65% marks (First class and distinction) and possess a minimum of five years of experience in office work, alongside good communication and management skills.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is below 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for IIT Hyderabad Office Assistant?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 23,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Hyderabad Office Assistant?
faq.answer: The application fee is not stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible applicants must apply online using the designated Google form link provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on academic background and experience, followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is on an ad hoc (contract basis) initially for a period of 11 months, which may be extended based on performance and departmental requirements.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be notified about the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates will be informed about the date of interviews after the shortlisting process is completed.
